name: zcliprect_clip_poly_no_uv_attr0_alt
description: zClipRect::ClipPoly_NoUV_WithAttr0_Alt clips the alternate XY bounds without UVs while preserving one attribute stream.

functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x47dfb0 validates xMin, xMaxAlt, yMin, and yMaxAlt clipping passes over g_Clip_PolyVerts with stack scratch buffers, g_Clip_PolyAttr0 interpolation, final copy-back when the scratch buffer is active, and rejection below three vertices.
The native smoke verifies single-plane xMin interpolation, four-plane alternate-bound clipping, attr0 preservation/interpolation, output bounds, and the zero-flag rejection path.
